leads.why_now: RK Logistics Group opened a new temperature-controlled Class A warehouse in the Austin/Cedar Park corridor in late July 2026, expanding its Central Texas footprint.
Metropolitan Warehouse and Delivery signed a 530,000 sq ft lease at a new Carneys Point, NJ logistics campus in September 2026.
RGL Logistics unveiled a 427,500 sq ft warehouse addition on its Appleton campus in October 2026, its 29th building.
FreezPak Logistics opened a large new temperature-controlled facility in Elizabeth, NJ in September 2026, expanding its port-area network.
King of Freight opened a new Colorado Springs office in September 2026 and plans to hire 100 people there by year end.
Verst Logistics opened a new Northern Kentucky Excellence Center in August 2026, bringing 75 staff under one roof to support growth.
Southern AG Carriers opened a new terminal facility in Albany, Georgia, with a ribbon cutting on September 15, 2026.

top_reasons.code: Too small (under 100 staff), e.g. G10 Fulfillment at 93 and RealCold at 98
Too big or part of a large corporate group
Not a logistics provider, or wrong company matched
Headquarters outside the US and UK

suggestions.why: Many regional warehouse and freight firms with fresh expansion news have 50 to 99 staff, and several were just under the minimum.
There were still good candidates left, but each one has to be checked before it can be submitted, and the budget ran out before we reached 10.
